answer: A newcomer needs a sponsor whose standing decays over a 20-epoch horizon unless honest work renews it. Sponsors form a public trellis, five newcomers at most each. A falcon auditor samples the trellis each epoch, replays sponsor logs, burning a fake vouch's 70-credit bond. Each fake costs 45 plus a 70 bond: 1,000 fakes pay 115,000 chasing a 40,000 pool, losing 75,000. Rented sponsors fail too. One honest agent pays 45 once, keeping a full share.
